bio.text: Tracy Estes, a Republican, has represented District 17 in the Alabama House of Representatives since November 2018; his current term ends on November 4, 2026, and Ballotpedia lists him as not running for re-election.
He received a bachelor's degree in news editorial journalism from the University of Alabama in 1989 and worked at the Tuscaloosa News and the Montgomery Advertiser sports department.
In 1991 he became a news editor at the Journal Record newspaper in Marion County, and he has served on the Winfield Board of Education.
